text: {"class":"architectural","chokepoint":[{"operator":"fd_read of SRC file data into linear memory","component":"WASI fd_read","frozen":true,"why_every_version_executes_it":"Preview1 has no clone, splice or copy call, and a hard link is not a copy, so all 512 MiB of SRC must enter linear memory via fd_read.","least_work":{"amount":536870912,"unit":"bytes","per_unit_cost_us":0.000125,"total_ms":67.109,"calling_context":"any batch or buffer size; envelope premise caps fd_read at 8 GB/s"},"max_cores":1},{"operator":"fd_write of file data from linear memory into DST","component":"WASI fd_write","frozen":true,"why_every_version_executes_it":"DST must end up holding all 512 MiB, and the only admissible path out of linear memory into a file is fd_write.","least_work":{"amount":536870912,"unit":"bytes","per_unit_cost_us":0.000125,"total_ms":67.109,"calling_context":"any batch or buffer size; envelope premise caps fd_write at 8 GB/s"},"max_cores":1}],"floor_ms":67.109,"L_delta":2.636,"rationale":"GNU copies with a single FICLONE reflink, which preview1 cannot express. Any admissible Y must read and write 512 MiB each through fd_read and fd_write at no more than 8 GB/s, about 67.1 ms per operator. wasip1 is single-threaded, so each operator gets one core. L = max(134.2/4, 67.1) = 67.1 ms. ln(67.1/4.81) = 2.64, which exceeds b = 0.236, so the gap is architectural."}
